integrity: Original full reasoning and standalone exact-arithmetic verification supplied; no claim of independent validation or proof beyond the stated domain.
scientific_limitations: Classification applies only to monic degree-four polynomials over finite fields. Derivative squarefreeness is weaker than distinct critical values. The counting argument proves the infinite-field statement; exact finite-field enumeration is corroboration. Equivalent coverage in broader historical discriminant-incidence literature remains possible.
title: Exact squarefree-derivative strata of quartic polynomials over finite fields
